title: Quietly Nutty Saudi Arabian Lamb Kebabs
description: A solo-dinner Saudi Arabian dish featuring lamb kebabs with a nutty flavor, pillowy texture, and high protein content, made with bicarbonate of soda and caramelized to perfection.
instructions: Preheat the grill to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, whisk together bicarbonate of soda, garlic powder, cumin, coriander, salt, and black pepper.
Add the lamb cubes to the bowl and toss to coat with the spice mixture.
Thread the lamb cubes onto skewers, leaving a small space between each cube.
Brush the lamb kebabs with olive oil and sprinkle with chopped almonds.
Grill the kebabs for 10-12 minutes, turning occasionally, until the lamb is cooked through.
Caramelize the almonds by cooking them in a skillet over medium heat for 2-3 minutes, stirring frequently.
Serve the lamb kebabs hot, garnished with caramelized almonds.
Let the kebabs rest for 5 minutes before serving.
